mode.title: Mode
mode.description: fixtures = every match of a day for the chosen sports (past, today or upcoming). live = in-play matches only. match = full detail for specific match IDs. reference = which sports are carrying data right now, probed live.
enumTitles: fixtures - matches by sport and day
match - full detail for match IDs

sportIds.title: Sports
sportIds.description: Sport IDs to scrape. 1 Football, 2 Tennis, 3 Basketball, 4 Ice Hockey, 5 American Football, 6 Baseball, 7 Handball, 10 Bandy, 11 Futsal, 12 Volleyball, 13 Cricket, 14 Darts, 15 Snooker, 21 Badminton. Run 'reference' mode to see what is live today. In 'match' mode this only labels the output - the detail feed ignores it.

dayOffsets.title: Days (fixtures mode)
dayOffsets.description: Which days to pull, relative to today: 0 = today, -1 = yesterday, 1 = tomorrow. Upstream serves roughly -7 to +7. Each sport/day combination gets an equal share of 'Max items'.

matchId.title: Match ID or URL (match mode)
matchId.description: A single Flashscore match ID (8 characters, e.g. WSSid6OM) or a full match URL. Match IDs come from the matchId field of fixtures/live runs.

matchIds.title: Match IDs or URLs (match mode)
matchIds.description: Multiple match IDs or URLs to fetch in one run.

includeSummary.title: Include incidents (match mode)
includeSummary.description: Goals, cards and substitutions with minute, player and side.

includeStatistics.title: Include statistics (match mode)
includeStatistics.description: Per-period statistics. For football this includes expected goals (xG), ball possession, shots, big chances and corners; other sports return their own stat set (e.g. aces and double faults for tennis).

includeLineups.title: Include lineups (match mode)
includeLineups.description: Formation, starting XI, bench and player ratings when the match published them. Not every match has lineups - the feed then returns nothing and the field is omitted.

includeHeadToHead.title: Include head-to-head (match mode)
includeHeadToHead.description: Previous meetings plus recent form for both teams.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Maximum match records per run (fixtures and live modes). Split evenly across the requested sport/day combinations.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency (match mode)
maxConcurrency.description: How many match IDs to fetch in parallel.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. The feed host served every recon request without a proxy; use one only if your region or IP is rate-limited.
